ideas.title: Cyberattacks on Water Systems: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cyberattacks on water systems in the US and the potential risks to public health and safety.
questions: What are the potential risks to public health and safety?
How can utilities protect themselves from cyberattacks?
ideas.insight: This is a significant concern for public health and safety. I will investigate the recent cyberattacks and look for any connections to other cases or entities.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud: A Costly Problem
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud and the potential costs to taxpayers.
questions: What are the potential costs to taxpayers?
How can Medicaid fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This is a significant problem that costs taxpayers millions of dollars. I will investigate the recent cases and look for any connections to other cases or entities.
